title: Sum of digits
statementMd: Return the sum of the decimal digits of a non-negative integer `n`. For example `digit_sum(472)` is `13`.
hints: `n % 10` gives the last digit and `n // 10` drops it.
solutionMd:
```python
def digit_sum(n):
    total = 0
    while n > 0:
        total += n % 10
        n //= 10
    return total
```

Repeatedly peel off the last digit with `% 10` and shift right with `// 10`.
